negative_trails.artifact: Stage 6 SOULKEYS — ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable duplicate key error
negative_trails.failure: PowerShell throws 'Item has already been added. Key in dictionary: run' when appending @{run=...; category=...; weight=...} to hashtable values. Non-fatal — index written with 443 terms.
negative_trails.root_cause: ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable returns case-sensitive ordered hashtables. When inner objects have 'run' key and you += @{run=...}, PowerShell's hashtable merge treats it as duplicate. Use [PSCustomObject]@{} or PSCustomObject array instead.
